mapper.select: SELECT chapter.title, chapter.chapterid, chapter.chapterno, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM 0721acgn.tb_cartoonpage page WHERE page.chapterid = chapter.chapterid AND page.fileurl IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(page.fileurl) != '' ) AS available FROM 0721acgn.tb_cartoonchapters chapter WHERE chapter.comicid = #{id} ORDER BY chapter.chapterno ASC
